title: Mitochondrial psychobiology
abstract: A field that uses mitochondria to unify biological and psychological sciences and to better understand the basis of health has emerged-Mitochondrial Psychobiology. Mitochondria are the body's cellular hubs for energy transformation and signaling. Mitochondria regulate functions as diverse as metabolism, gene expression, and stress adaptation; consequently, their dysregulation is linked to most chronic illnesses and aging. Here, we propose that mitochondria provide a mechanistic bridge between body and the measurable functions of the mind, including perception, cognition, emotion, and behavior. From this perspective, mitochondria provide a scientifically tractable interface through which bioenergetic processes relate to subjective experiences and behaviors. We outline foundational principles for Mitochondrial Psychobiology, discuss the key gaps that the field needs to address to advance our understanding of mind-mitochondria relationships across the lifecourse, and review emerging approaches to probe the mind-mitochondria connection across levels. This stimulating scientific challenge is a unique opportunity to train the next generation of interdisciplinary scientists, resolve conceptual and technical challenges spanning temporal and spatial scales, and develop a more accurate, holistic model of health. Rooted in general energetic principles, Mitochondrial Psychobiology is poised to productively steer biomedicine over the coming decades.
abstract_zh: 一个利用线粒体统一生物学与心理学、更好地理解健康基础的研究领域已崛起——线粒体心理生物学。线粒体是人体细胞内的能量转化与信号枢纽。它们调节包括代谢、基因表达和应激适应在内的多种功能；因此，其功能障碍与大多数慢性疾病和衰老密切相关。在此，我们提出线粒体为身心之间提供了一个机制桥梁，其中包括感知、认知、情绪和行为等可测量的心理功能。从这一视角出发，线粒体为生物能量过程与主观体验及行为之间的关系提供了一个科学上可检验的接口。我们阐述了线粒体心理生物学的基础原则，讨论了该领域为推进生命历程中线粒体与心理关系的理解所需解决的关键空白，并综述了在不同层面探究线粒体-心理连接的新兴方法。这一富有启发性的科学挑战是训练下一代跨学科科学家的独特机遇，也是解决跨时间与空间尺度的概念与技术难题，并构建更精准、更具整体性健康模型的契机。根植于普遍的能量原理，线粒体心理生物学有望在未来几十年内引导生物医学产生富有成效的进展。
